description: Control your CardputerZero from a browser on your network

store.summary: Control your Cardputer from a browser: screen, shell, files, apps and Wi-Fi
store.description: Open ZeroDesk and it shows an address and a one-time pairing code. Enter them in a browser on the same network to get the Cardputer's live screen with a working copy of its keyboard (plus paste, screenshots and recordings), a shell, a file browser, store installs, Wi-Fi and VPN controls, and CPU, memory, battery and network stats. HTTPS and local network only; runs as your user; admin actions ask for your password. Remote typing needs one reboot after the first install.
